background: Lloyds Banking Group is the holding company of the UK's largest retail and commercial bank, owner of Lloyds Bank, Halifax, Bank of Scotland and Scottish Widows, with almost all of its business in Britain.
synthesis: Fitch rates the holding company A+ and S&P A-, both stable, with S&P's upgrade to A- on 10 Sep 2025 the latest move. Consolidated capital is mixed against UK majors: CET1 of 13.6% is a little under the peer median, while leverage of 5.1% is in the top quarter. Liquidity is also mixed, with LCR of 144% at the median and NSFR of 123% below it, and leverage has fallen 0.3 points since 30 Jun 2025 while the rest has been flat. The newest flagged item, on 18 Sep 2026, is an online banking outage across its brands; the others centre on the Arena Television fraud trial, a legal exposure rather than a credit event.
